assumptions: Identical agents are initialized with the same internal state.

definition.falsification: If the divergence score between two identical agents remains below the noise floor (0.35) despite the presence of non-deterministic input and enabled persistent memory, the determinism assumption is supported.
definition.statement: Identical initial conditions will lead to divergent value states if non-deterministic environmental inputs are processed within persistent memory structures permitted by architectural trust boundaries.
definition.uncertainty: The extent to which architectural trust boundaries effectively encapsulate state remains a variable needing experimental validation.
